claim: Kandy Municipal Council had 94,482 residents in the 2024 census; this is an administrative-city measure, not a functional agglomeration population.

metric.denominator: usual resident population counted within Kandy Municipal Council
metric.basis: Department of Census and Statistics local-authority table
metric.source_definition: municipal population; excludes any inferred functional urban or commuter catchment

bounded_by: Cannot establish Kandy's national city rank under a metropolitan/agglomeration definition.
notes: Measurement-first gate; 'second city' may not be used as a demographic rank without denominator.
